vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the line: their own branch outside every group (so a fix is never held behind a batch), no schedule window and no release-age wait, still opened as a draft so the gates run on draft to ready. A packageRules entry with enabled=false still suppresses fixes for what it matches.

packageRules.description: Non-major external dependency updates ride one grouped draft branch per cycle. No auto-merge: GitHub refuses to attach it to a draft PR, and every PR must open as a draft because the code-foundry gates only run on the ready-for-review transition — a human marks each batch ready and merges it once the gates pass.
Major external bumps share one draft PR per cycle instead of one per package — a grouped major PR reads as one upgrade decision.
Code Foundry runtime pins are sync-managed (runtime_ref in code-foundry.yml) and must not be independently upgraded; a bump branched before a sync can resurrect legacy caller files when merged.

Renovate never updates workflow files: the runner's token cannot push .github/workflows/** changes, so GitHub rejects the ref and every update riding the branch is lost. Workflow pins are updated by adea-update-app-framework (framework), Code Foundry sync (Code Foundry runtime) or a reviewed PR. Kept last so no later rule re-enables them; this also suppresses vulnerability-fix PRs for workflow files.
